claims.text: Nonsevere initial episode or first recurr: either metronidazole or vanco;
claims.quote: Either metronidazole or vancomycin is recommended for the treatment of children with an initial episode or first recurrence of nonsevere CDI

claims.text: Severe initial episode: PO vanco over metronidazole.
claims.quote: For children with an initial episode of severe CDI, oral vancomycin is recommended over metronidazole

claims.text: Second or later recurr: PO vanco over metronidazole.
claims.quote: For children with a second or greater episode of recurrent CDI, oral vancomycin is recommended over metronidazole

claims.text: Fidaxomicin (label): indicated in pediatric pts ≥ 6 mo for C. diff-associated diarrhea;
claims.quote: DIFICID® is indicated in adult and pediatric patients aged 6 months and older for the treatment of C. difficile-associated diarrhea (CDAD).

claims.text: ≥ 12.5 kg and able to swallow tablets: one 200 mg tablet PO BID for 10 days.
claims.quote: Pediatric patients weighing at least 12.5 kg and able to swallow tablets: One 200 mg tablet orally twice daily for 10 days.
